verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.

xrefs.text: This is what the LORD says: “I will restore the fortunes of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings. And the city will be rebuilt on her own ruins, and the palace will stand in its rightful place.
Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Now I will restore Jacob from captivity and will have compassion on the whole house of Israel, and I will be jealous for My holy name.
“Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?
Then the LORD became jealous for His land, and He spared His people.

verses.text: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah

xrefs.text: Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
Of David. A Maskil. Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our trespasses,
Pardon, I pray, the iniquity of this people, in keeping with the greatness of Your loving devotion, just as You have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.”
Through Him everyone who believes is justified from everything from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

verses.text: You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.

xrefs.text: So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
Nothing devoted to destruction shall cling to your hands, so that the LORD will turn from His fierce anger, grant you mercy, show you compassion, and multiply you as He swore to your fathers,
In that day you will say: “O LORD, I will praise You. Although You were angry with me, Your anger has turned away, and You have comforted me.
Who knows? God may turn and relent; He may turn from His fierce anger, so that we will not perish.”
And yet He was compassionate; He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them. He often restrained His anger and did not unleash His full wrath.

verses.text: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.

xrefs.text: Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
Restore us to Yourself, O LORD, so we may return; renew our days as of old,
Restore us, O God of Hosts, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
I have surely heard Ephraim’s moaning: ‘You disciplined me severely, like an untrained calf. Restore me, that I may return, for You are the LORD my God.

verses.text: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?

xrefs.text: How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
O LORD God of Hosts, how long will Your anger smolder against the prayers of Your people?
A Maskil of Asaph. Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?
Do not be angry, O LORD, beyond measure; do not remember our iniquity forever. Oh, look upon us, we pray; we are all Your people!
Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has His anger shut off His compassion?” Selah

verses.text: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?

xrefs.text: O LORD, I have heard the report of You; I stand in awe, O LORD, of Your deeds. Revive them in these years; make them known in these years. In Your wrath, remember mercy!
Then we will not turn away from You; revive us, and we will call on Your name.

For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the oppressed and humble in spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite.
Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
After two days He will revive us; on the third day He will raise us up, that we may live in His presence.

verses.text: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.

xrefs.text: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
He who sacrifices a thank offering honors Me, and to him who rightly orders his way, I will show the salvation of God.”
And I will show you compassion, and he will have compassion on you and restore you to your own land.’

verses.text: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.

xrefs.text: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
Those I love I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
I will stand at my guard post and station myself on the ramparts. I will watch to see what He will say to me, and how I should answer when corrected.

And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem, and the bow of war will be broken. Then He will proclaim peace to the nations. His dominion will extend from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.

verses.text: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.

xrefs.text: I am bringing My righteousness near; it is not far away, and My salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion and adorn Israel with My splendor.
For I will be a wall of fire around it, declares the LORD, and I will be the glory within it.’”
If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “After His Glory has sent Me against the nations that have plundered you— for whoever touches you touches the apple of His eye—
a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and for glory to Your people Israel.

verses.text: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.

xrefs.text: Never let loving devotion or faithfulness leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
Then justice will inhabit the wilderness, and righteousness will dwell in the fertile field.
For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.

verses.text: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.

xrefs.text: Drip down, O heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness. Let the earth open up that salvation may sprout and righteousness spring up with it; I, the LORD, have created it.
Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.

And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true— in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
The LORD was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to magnify His law and make it glorious.
While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!

verses.text: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.

xrefs.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.
Then He will send rain for the seed that you have sown in the ground, and the food that comes from your land will be rich and plentiful. On that day your cattle will graze in open pastures.

verses.text: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.

xrefs.text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked.
I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
